insight: Unveiled at Google I/O 2025 as Google's first dedicated AI filmmaking tool, built around Veo.
name: Google Flow
tagline: Google's AI filmmaking studio — Veo video + Imagen, in one canvas.
description: Google Labs' creative studio for filmmakers — generate and stitch shots with Veo, craft keyframes with Imagen, and direct camera + scene with a Gemini-powered agent. Now folds in Whisk and ImageFX.
edge: Veo 3.1 native dialogue + lip-sync in a real timeline (Scenebuilder, clip-extend); the most capable free video tier.
cons: Locked to Veo, no multi-model switching
